en.description:
Crown Prix is an arcade racing game designed exclusively for Apple Watch. Your Digital Crown becomes the steering wheel: turn it to carve through corners, feel every apex through your wrist, and chase the perfect lap on 24 real-world Grand Prix circuits. One lap, flat out — every run is a time trial against drivers around the world.

Apple Watch is REQUIRED to play the game

[Key Features]
- Digital Crown Steering: Steer with nothing but the crown. The throttle is handled for you — run wide open on the straights, then wind the crown to scrub speed through the corners. Arcade-simple controls with a real motorsport feel, built for the wrist.
- Full 2026 Calendar: All 24 circuits from the 2026 Formula 1 season, from the tight hairpins of Monaco to the high-speed sweeps of Spa and Silverstone. Every track is recreated from real circuit geometry — simulator-accurate layouts at arcade pace.
- Purple Sectors: Every circuit is split into three timed sectors. Go green when you beat your personal best — go purple when you set the fastest sector time in the world.
- Global Leaderboards: A Game Center leaderboard for every circuit, plus sector record boards. See the world's top 10, your exact rank, and who owns each purple sector.
- World Championship: The top 10 drivers on each circuit score F1-style points (25-18-15...). Points across all 24 circuits combine into a global drivers' championship — climb the standings one lap at a time.
- Race-Day Presentation: Five red lights, then lights out. A live minimap, speed readout, and sector pills keep you on the pace, with haptic feedback for the start, every wall tap, and every new record.
- Make It Your Car: Choose from 8 liveries with a live preview, and see your color on track and on the minimap.
- iPhone Companion App: Browse every leaderboard, purple sector record, and the championship standings right from your iPhone.

No ads, no in-app purchases — pay once and race forever.

Thirty seconds is all a lap takes. Put on your watch, wait for lights out, and go claim your purple sectors.
en.releaseNotes:
The World Championship is here — and every leaderboard starts fresh. New season, clean grid, everything to race for.

[New]
- World Championship: The top 10 drivers on each circuit now score F1-style points (25-18-15...). Points from all 24 circuits combine into global standings — follow them on your Watch or in the new Championship tab on iPhone.
- Car colors: Choose from 8 liveries with a live preview. Your color shows on track and on the minimap.

[Improved]
- Fresh leaderboards: Every lap time and sector board has been reset for the new season. Set your times again and claim the early purple sectors.
- Long circuit and player names now scroll smoothly instead of getting cut off.
- Your personal bests sync from Game Center before every race.

[Fixed]
- Driving backwards across the line no longer counts as a lap. Nice try.
- New barriers at the Monaco and Circuit Gilles Villeneuve hairpins stop corner-cutting — honest laps only.

Lights out — the championship season starts now.

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
"It’s lights out and away we go!"

Pre-season Testing Complete
- The wait for the green light is finally over. All systems checked; it’s time to hit the track.

Telemetry Upgrade
- Your race engineer has secured advanced analytical tools. Monitor sector times, delta to P1, and fastest lap detection—all in real-time.

Pit Wall Data Sync
- Your personal bests are precious. With seamless synchronization between Game Center and your device, you’ll never lose data over the team radio again.

Dedicated Companion App
- Clock 'Purple Sectors' on the leaderboard and connect directly to the Paddock for feedback. Your voice drives the engineering direction of our next update.

Car Setup & Track Maintenance
- Steering Calibration: Refined handling feedback for the Digital Crown. 
- New POV: Added camera positions to help you find the perfect racing line.
- Track Detail: Custom curb painting and track resurfacing for Zandvoort, Jeddah, and Lusail.

"Box, Box, Box!"

Position Board Upgrade
- Your race engineer has recalibrated the timing screens. Rankings are now colour-coded — P1 glows purple, P2-P3 in green, the midfield pack in yellow — so you can read the grid at a glance. Driver count added to every leaderboard.

Formation Lap Shortcut
- No need to scroll back to the paddock. Fire up a race straight from the leaderboard — one tap and you're on the grid.

Purple Sectors on the Pit Wall
- Your personal best sector splits now glow purple on the Watch leaderboard. The ultimate bragging rights, right on your wrist.

Paddock Pass
- A new info panel on the iOS app. Find the developer's website, GitHub, LinkedIn, and a direct line to send feedback to the engineering room.

Reliability Upgrade
- Radio Timeout Guard: Watch-to-iPhone messages now carry a 10-second timeout so comms never hang indefinitely.
- Backup Frequency: If the primary radio channel fails, data automatically routes through a secondary link.
- Double-Transmission Fix: Resolved a rare issue where the same message fired twice, causing a pit lane penalty (crash).
